title: Tormented in Italian Alley
description: A surreal scene of a screaming woman in the foreground whose head is being grabbed and pulled by multiple grotesque hands emerging from a swirling vortex of light and foliage. She stands in a narrow, colorful Italian alleyway with stone steps leading toward the Colosseum under a bright sky, with laundry hanging between the vibrant buildings.
